import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variant
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'chinstrap': 'Chinstrap'})
    # Fix island label variant (strip whitespace)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    # Convert text numbers to actual numbers
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    # Handle out of range body_mass_g (max allowed is 6500)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Drop rows with missing sex (unknown, do not guess)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['sex'])
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
